node-taglib-sharp returns RIFF INFO values with the trailing NUL terminator (tag.title/comment/genres and InfoTag.getValuesAsStrings); a read-then-save round trip writes the NUL back as data inside the sub-chunk size. ffprobe hides NULs, so NUL evidence comes from raw INFO bytes (tests/main/riff-chunks.ts parseListInfoSubChunks or an equivalent dump), never from ffprobe alone.

Number('120\0') is NaN; metadata.ts falls back to 0 for NUL-terminated numeric custom INFO values. MetadataPanel.tsx:76 sends the whole editingMetadata on save, so any field read wrong is written back.

music-metadata decodes RIFF INFO UTF-8 non-Latin text as mojibake (C R6). For INFO text fields compare raw hex + ffprobe; music-metadata stays the independent reader for Latin/ASCII values and ID3 frames.
